detailZones.title: Screen and seat pocket
detailZones.description: A dark screen is set into the seat ahead, above a latch and a travel magazine in the rigid seat pocket.

detailZones.title: Window and sky
detailZones.description: An oval window in the cream cabin wall frames blue sky and banks of white clouds.

detailZones.title: Tray table and fittings
detailZones.description: A blue removable meal tray sits on a pale fold-down table. The metal support and pivot are exposed near the aisle.

detailZones.title: Meal, drink and cutlery
detailZones.description: Pasta, broccoli, salad and a bread roll sit beside a drink. A fork and knife rest on a folded white napkin.

detailZones.title: Seat and lap belt
detailZones.description: The navy seat has a padded headrest, two gray armrests, woven upholstery and the two separated halves of a lap belt.

detailZones.title: Pillow, headphones and blanket
detailZones.description: A U-shaped neck pillow, a pair of wired headphones and a folded gray blanket lie separately on the blue seat.

detailZones.title: Bag below the seat
detailZones.description: A small canvas bag sits on the speckled carpet near a metal seat foot. Its handles and outer pocket are visible.

anchorAudit.rationale: Points follow the objects visible around the window seat, including the screen, lap belt, soft goods, meal and bag. Seat preferences and measurements are available in the index.
